summary.text: Trojan whom Polydamas son of Panthous smote full upon the breast with his spear when Meges son of Phyleus leapt upon him and missed — no homonym in the atlas.

story.text: Meges saw Polydamas and leapt upon him, but Polydamas swerved from beneath him and Meges missed; for Apollo would not suffer the son of Panthous to be vanquished. With a spear-thrust Polydamas smote Croesmus full upon the breast, and he fell with a thud.
